rationale: The reporter labelled it a bug, but the report describes no command, error text, or reproduction. The docs (docs/concepts/python-versions.md) say .python-version is created by uv python pin (or uv python pin --global), and nothing says uv venv --python writes it, so the reporter appears to expect a write that uv does not document. That reads as a misunderstanding or a request for new behaviour rather than a bug, so question is the lean; enhancement is the alternative if the reporter wants uv venv to update the pin. The install-python guide and search_issues (no matching duplicate; the only hit was unrelated, #4022) did not settle it. needs_mre is true because a maintainer cannot tell what was run or what changed the venv from the post alone.
